dialect.detail: IBM mainframe-style COBOL with LINE SEQUENTIAL files, COPY statements with REPLACING, COMP-3, 88-level condition names, and proprietary copybooks (MUDEF, MSTRPL, AHDEF, MSTPMPM, etc.) typical of an IBM mainframe or compatible environment running an Employee Benefit/retirement plan system.
evidence: EXEC-style copybook patterns (IOPARM, PRMSD, ENVIA, PRMDE)

purpose.domain_detail: Employee Benefit Systems - retirement plan remittance confirmation extract. Produces a REMCONF extract file fed to another application to print participant contribution confirmations.
purpose.summary: Program CNF1000E produces a remittance confirmation extract file (CNFEXT/CNFEXTV) for an Employee Benefit/retirement plan system. It processes participant and plan-level records, accumulates contribution totals by source, and writes output records for both standard and Vista-only confirmations. It calls multiple subprograms to retrieve plan, participant, division, and source control data.

notable_features: OCCURS tables for division and source control data
REDEFINES used for record type switching (detail/summary)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
